init.description: Leave email and password blank to keep them. The fixed price calculates energy excluding tax over the entire history. Optional dated periods estimate total supply costs including power, rental and taxes, from each date until the next. The last period remains in effect until updated. Credits are not deducted. Clearing periods stops updates but retains previously generated statistics.
